description_en: Retrieves the list of certificates for a user
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-certs --domain example.aliyun.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd0000tb02 --algorithm SM2 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfmoiy0000p2oq --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCerts

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为10，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: The Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of your current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the encryption algorithm. Valid values:

NotSM2 (default): Specifies a non-ShangMi (SM) cryptographic algorithm.

SM2: Specifies an SM cryptographic algorithm
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法类型。取值：

NotSM2（默认）：表示非国密算法。

SM2：表示国密算法
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
